basic_info.description: In the heart of SF's sought-after Midtown Terrace neighborhood, this light-filled single-family home offers an incredible opportunity to expand, and make it your own. Lovingly cared for by the same family for over 50 years, this two-bedroom, one-bath residence blends mid-century character with modern potential. The open living and dining area features a wall of windows that fill the space with natural light and offer peek-a-boo city views on the horizon.  Hardwood floors and freshly painted interiors create a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout. The kitchen and bath are ready for your creative touch, providing a blank canvas for updates that reflect your personal style. With approximately 950 square feet on one level, the home sits above a spacious garage, approx. 700 sq. ft, that presents an exciting development opportunity perfect for expanding into additional living space. The terraced backyard patio offers a private outdoor retreat ideal for gardening or entertaining. Located on a quiet, friendly street just steps from public transportation, freeway access, and nearby restaurants and shopping, this home is a rare find a peaceful urban retreat with room to grow. A fantastic alternative to condominium living, it's move-in ready today and brimming with potential for tomorrow.
